about: 0.9.4: Home Assistant's round on shared fixtures, run through src/lib/haSync.ts and haMatch.ts (src/lib/haParity.test.ts) and through HaSync.java and HaMatch.java (tools/sync-test HaSyncTest.java), which must give the same answers. `expect` is what haSync.ts gives (rewrite it with HA_FIXTURES_WRITE=1 npx vitest run src/lib/haParity.test.ts after a deliberate change to haSync.ts, then port the change to Java).
